decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (No 05; No 06 Rev: A; No 07; No 08; Unnumbered Location Plan; Unnumbered Site/Block Plan.) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the  flank walls of the extension hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - The outbuilding hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as [9 Wigley Road, Feltham, TW13 5HD], nor shall any kitchen facilities be installed into the outbuilding without the permission of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension to form granny annexe.
